a2t_calibration_d1_basis: Unlike the sealed frozen 400 -- whose ids are inside the base D1 closure and which therefore declares NO supplement -- the @ts2 ids are new media that duplicate nothing in that closure, so an additive supplement is both needed and legal under contracts.gate_media_identity.
a2t_calibration_exposure: The same frozen 400 discovery split, re-encoded. Nothing is drawn. Media row SAEA-SN-MF-A2T-CAL400-TS2-MEDIA-V1. This fragment grants no contact authority.
a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted @ts2 sample ids of THIS variant; a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)), the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time. Both differ from the sealed frozen 400's, which is the identity separation the @ts2 suffix exists to guarantee.
